title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Saw I missed your call. Was on the phone with my wife and she has priority over ALL. Hope you are well. I haven’t talked with Gardy in about ten day so I don’t have any news on what we plan on doing here in the coming days. Saw today that we signed Moore so I’m looking forward to seeing what Rick Anderson can do for him.
No problem at all, was just calling to chat. How is she doing?

She seems to be doing fine. We had all our kids with baby granddaughter in town for a week and that wore her down. She and my daughter are at a basketball game about 50 miles South by themselves. I ran a fever yesterday and coughed my head off. (Must have gotten the wrong Strain of flu shot.) Hope all is well with your situation.
I did not get the job. I still have a job. Still uncertainty, but my trip to Malta was a lifetime highlight. Overall, things are good. Hope you feel better
